description: Source code for a controller module within an Android device testing and orchestration system, handling various HTTP API endpoints for managing CVD instances, artifacts, logs, and operations.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the orchestrator controller, including paths, service URLs, and user info.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main HTTP controller handling routes for managing CVDS, artifacts, logs, operations, and debug info.

classes.name: fetchArtifactsHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler for fetching artifacts using the build API.

classes.name: createCVDHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to create a new CVD instance.

classes.name: listCVDsHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler for listing existing CVDs.

classes.name: execCVDCommandHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler for executing commands on CVDs such as start, stop, remove, etc.

classes.name: createSnapshotHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to create a snapshot of a CVD.

classes.name: startCVDHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to start a CVD.

classes.name: getCVDLogsHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to serve logs of a specific CVD.

classes.name: listOperationsHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler for listing ongoing operations.

classes.name: getOperationHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to get details of a specific operation.

classes.name: getOperationResultHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to get the result of a specific operation.

classes.name: waitOperationHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler that waits for an operation to complete or timeout.

classes.name: createCVDBugReportHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to create a bug report for a CVD.

classes.name: downloadCVDBugReportHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to download a bug report archive.

classes.name: deleteCVDBugReportHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to delete a bug report.

classes.name: createUploadDirectoryHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to create user artifact upload directory.

classes.name: listUploadDirectoriesHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to list user artifact upload directories.

classes.name: createUpdateUserArtifactHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to upload or update user artifacts in chunks.

classes.name: extractUserArtifactHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to trigger extraction of a user artifact asynchronously.

classes.name: getDebugVariablesHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler to retrieve debug variables.

classes.name: okHandler
classes.description: Simple handler returning 200 OK for health checks.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Process HTTP requests for each handler class, producing appropriate responses or errors.
